descriptions.text: Provide the perfect finishing touch for your cards with Stampin' Up!'s high-quality envelopes. Fits standard 5-1/2" x 4-1/4" cards. * 40 envelopes * Very Vanilla * Envelope size: 5-3/4" x 4-3/8" (14.6 x 11.1 cm)

images.description: A cream or ivory colored envelope with a curved flap closure, displayed flat against a neutral beige background. The envelope appears to be a standard A-2 or greeting card size with a smooth finish and subtle shadow detail.

descriptions.text: Provide the perfect finishing touch for your cards with Stampin' Up!'s high-quality envelopes. Fits standard 5-1/2" x 4-1/4" (14 x 10.8 cm) cards. * 40 envelopes * Whisper White * Envelope size: 5-3/4" x 4-3/8" (14.6 x 11.1 cm)

images.description: A white envelope product displayed against a gray background, showing a standard horizontal flap closure design. The envelope appears to be a blank, unprinted card or invitation envelope with clean lines and professional presentation.
